actionable_findings.title: Separate one-off consolidation from replayable migrations
actionable_findings.fact: September migration creates agentnexos_demo_requests; October consolidation intentionally raises TARGET_NOT_EMPTY if any agentnexos table exists. Therefore sequential replay of all committed migrations stops, by inspection; no database reset was run.
actionable_findings.impact: Fresh environments, restores and future schema changes cannot safely rely on this directory as one linear history. It does not establish an outage of the current database.
actionable_findings.next: Establish the authoritative baseline/history and a non-destructive follow-up migration path before M5. Preserve existing production schema/data.
actionable_findings.live_database_followup: Actual history contains only consolidation version 20261013003209; committed consolidation filename is 20261013003126. Public schema/policies correspond to that family.

actionable_findings.title: Privacy notice lags public account functionality
actionable_findings.fact: Rendered privacy copy lists brief, model demo, hosting and request metadata. Signup, email confirmation, password recovery and browser session handling were added, but account-data processing is not described in that notice.
actionable_findings.impact: The public privacy explanation no longer covers every visible data flow. No legal-compliance determination or account defect is asserted.
actionable_findings.next: Document real Supabase Auth email/account/session processing, retention/deletion and responsible contact after owner confirms actual settings. Keep fictional-data guidance for demo prompts separate.

actionable_findings.title: Retention has no scheduled enforcement
actionable_findings.fact: Reservation SQL deletes records older than 48 hours only on a new request. Source has no cron/job; live privacy notice accurately says there is no maximum deletion deadline.
actionable_findings.impact: Inactive sites can retain older quota/trace metadata beyond the nominal period.
actionable_findings.next: Implement an owner-approved scheduled cleanup with job result/oldest-row monitoring in its own authorized package. Do not change production data in this review.
actionable_findings.live_database_followup: Catalog confirms no pg_cron extension or cron.job relation, and live reservation function contains request-triggered 48-hour DELETE. External scheduler not inspected here.

actionable_findings.title: Public answer is text, not a typed editable deliverable
actionable_findings.fact: A typed design contract exists as tool input/review, while reviewer streams final free text and UI exports conversation Markdown. There is no final WorkflowBrief schema/state store/resume contract.
actionable_findings.impact: A stronger public product can provide an editable process brief with sources, missing facts, risks, checks and precise connection status. Current read-only demo remains honest.
actionable_findings.next: Promote deterministic review results into a typed final draft and exportable artifact; keep external execution disabled.

actionable_findings.title: Phase ledger contradicts completed public releases
actionable_findings.fact: Top table retains M1–M8 PENDING while subsequent batch/review sections and current production source contain completed public work.
actionable_findings.impact: The next executor can repeat delivered work or overstate whole-stage completion.
actionable_findings.next: Reconcile per-capability status with source, deployment and reused evidence; leave enterprise gates open.

actionable_findings.title: Header policy is not encoded in app configuration
actionable_findings.fact: Next config only configures images; proxy handles locale/alias redirects. No explicit CSP/frame/referrer/permissions/nosniff policy is defined there.
actionable_findings.impact: M7 hardening requirement is not closed by source. Platform headers may already supply a subset; their live state was not rechecked.
actionable_findings.next: Inventory actual response headers once in the next authorized release and introduce a compatible policy within owner testing rules.

actionable_findings.title: Inactive enterprise prototypes must remain separated from live capability claims
actionable_findings.fact: Legacy coordinator, in-memory approvals/memory/idempotency and static enterprise lookup are reachable from test scripts but not active app/API imports. Enterprise endpoints are closed.
actionable_findings.impact: Their presence and passing historical tests do not establish tenant-safe durable approvals, real retrieval or execution.
actionable_findings.next: Retain fail-closed endpoints; label or archive prototype modules when implementation scope permits, and build M5/M6 contracts before activation.

actionable_findings.title: Release verifier trusts its supplied commit label
actionable_findings.fact: Manual workflow checks out the entered released_commit and verifier records it, but the script has no deployment-metadata lookup/comparison. Current session deployment linkage exists separately in prior audit evidence.
actionable_findings.impact: A future successful run can be attributed to an incorrect input SHA unless release metadata is separately checked.
actionable_findings.next: Attach independently read deployment/domain/source linkage to each release manifest; do not rerun current checks.

actionable_findings.title: Arabic social shares use English artwork
actionable_findings.fact: All locale metadata points to one OG endpoint whose headline is English.
actionable_findings.impact: Arabic sharing is technically valid but falls short of the bilingual artwork requirement.
actionable_findings.next: Create locale-aware branded OG variants after content approval.

positive_controls: Server feature flag and explicit provider/database readiness fail closed.
No browser service key in reviewed active client modules; secret reads are server-side.
API rejects cross-origin requests, non-JSON, oversized bodies, wrong roles/parts and excess context.
Quota is database-atomic across instances with HMAC subject, per-connection/global caps and active request lock.
Public tools never authorize external writes; fixed reference IDs/URLs reject redirects and enforce byte/time budgets.
Model/workflow retries are zero; per-call outputs, total deadline, tool calls and journal length are bounded.
Metadata journal persistence failure stops success; active public flow does not store raw prompt/answer text.
Current legal copy accurately distinguishes model requests from local brief and discloses on-demand retention.
limitations: No new browser/API/SQL probes, tests, typecheck/lint/build, package installs, deployment or repository edits.
Live Vercel/DNS/firewall/account configuration was not re-read here; reuse earlier evidence and separate access investigation.
No authenticated account or production customer/tenant flow; auth email delivery and session roundtrip remain unverified.

Initial schema/RLS conclusions were source-only; authorized live follow-up now verifies catalog grants/policies/FKs and migration history. User-session behavior, live data and backups remain unverified.
No exploit or live security incident established. Missing application headers are a planned-hardening gap, not proof of a vulnerability.
Site Unavailable in separate NEXA cloud computer cannot be attributed to source from this review; no site-level outage reproduced in reused public evidence.
Visual/design quality and new professional copy proposal belong to parallel review; this artifact establishes truth boundaries for those recommendations.
